paper_title: Mechanistic Understanding and Mitigation of Language Confusion in   English-Centric Large Language Models
caption: Distribution of Important Neurons Associated with Confusion Points in Llama3-8B. (a) Distribution of the top 300 most important FFN neurons across layers for an individual Chinese prompt “UTF8gbsn请解释拆东墙补西墙的意思。(Please explain `UTF8gbsn拆东墙补西墙.')” from Aya. (b) Aggregated distribution of important neuron scores across all Chinese test samples in Aya.
model_annotation:
The image presents two line diagrams, each displaying the distribution of important neurons associated with confusion points in Llama3-8B. 

The x-axis in both diagrams is labeled "layer" and ranges from 0 to 35, with a linear scale and interval of 5 units. 

The y-axis in both diagrams is labeled "count" and ranges from 0 to 175 in the second diagram and 0 to 100 in the first, with a linear scale.

Diagram (a) shows a blue line representing "Llama3 FFN value neurons". The line starts at approximately 10 on the y-axis at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 10-15 until layer 20, then increases to around 20 at layer 25, and sharply rises to approximately 90 at layer 30.

Diagram (b) shows a green line representing "Llama3 FFN value neurons". The line starts at 0 on the y-axis at layer 0, increases slightly to around 5 at layer 10, remains relatively stable around 5-10 until layer 28, then sharply rises to approximately 160 at layer 32.

model_annotations.English:
The plot consists of two line graphs. The x-axis in both graphs is labeled "layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis in both graphs is labeled "count" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 175 in the bottom graph and 0 to 100 in the top graph.

In the top graph, a blue line with circular markers and a solid style represents Llama3 FFN value neurons. This line starts around 10 and remains relatively stable until layer 28, where it increases to around 90 at layer 30.

In the bottom graph, a green line with circular markers and a solid style represents Llama3 FFN value neurons. This line starts at 0 and remains at 0 until layer 29, where it sharply increases to around 150 at layer 31.
